mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_AUTOFIX (INQUIRY_ID, ISSUE_NO, REQUESTED_BY) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{issueNo}, #{requestedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE INS_DAY >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE 1=1 AND INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'WORKING', 'READY')
mapper.sql: A.ID AS "id" ,A.INQUIRY_ID AS "inquiryId" ,A.ISSUE_NO AS "issueNo" ,A.PR_NO AS "prNo" ,A.BRANCH AS "branch" ,A.STATUS AS "status" ,A.SUMMARY AS "summary" ,A.FILES AS "files" ,A.ERROR AS "error" ,A.RUN_URL AS "runUrl" ,I.TITLE AS "inquiryTitle" ,I.AI_SUMMARY AS "inquirySummary" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM A.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM A.UPD_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "updAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_AUTOFIX A LEFT JOIN T_INQUIRY I ON I.ID = A.INQUIRY_ID WHERE A.ID = #{id}
SELECT FROM T_AUTOFIX A LEFT JOIN T_INQUIRY I ON I.ID = A.INQUIRY_ID WHERE A.ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo}
SELECT FROM T_AUTOFIX A LEFT JOIN T_INQUIRY I ON I.ID = A.INQUIRY_ID ORDER BY A.ID DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AUTOFIX WHERE STATUS = 'READY'
mapper.update: UPDATE T_AUTOFIX SET STATUS = #{status} ,PR_NO = COALESCE(#{prNo}, PR_NO) ,BRANCH = COALESCE(#{branch}, BRANCH) ,SUMMARY = COALESCE(#{summary}, SUMMARY) ,FILES = COALESCE(#{files}, FILES) ,ERROR = #{error} ,RUN_URL = COALESCE(#{runUrl}, RUN_URL) ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo} AND STATUS NOT IN ('MERGED', 'REJECTED')
